name: Watanuki Shinobu
source: The homeroom teacher of the Fuzzy Rose Colors class who also works as the school nurse. She is often in a bad mood and tends to push her duties onto her students (especially onto [url=/c50232]Kousuke[/url]). Despite this Shinobu is proficient when it comes to her work. Also loves smoking.
translation: The homeroom teacher of the Fuzzy Rose Colors class who also works as the school nurse. She is often in a bad mood and tends to push her duties onto her students (especially onto [url=/c50232]Kousuke[/url]). Despite this Shinobu is proficient when it comes to her work. Also loves smoking.
